parameters.multiple: Whether more than one section may stand open.
parameters.collapsible: Whether the open section may be shut again (with none open after).
parameters.expanded: Controls whether the detail is expanded. Leave it unset for internal state.
parameters.initiallyExpanded: The sections open at first, by value.
parameters.onExpansionChanged: Told the section pressed and whether it is now open.
parameters.size: Selects the size of the component.
parameters.expandIconPosition: Places the expansion indicator at the start or end.
